description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying {8}{U}{U}
Holding priority, activate Haystack by paying {2} and tapping it, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
During your first extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.name: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
